title: Note contract
description: The only change request between roles. A note is a JSON list of objects with these six fields, all required, and two optional ones that carry its state (status, closed_in). The legacy target name 'bible' is accepted as an alias of 'canon' by the validator. The state of a note in a frozen ledger, which is never edited, lives in the state ledger of the notes (notes-status.schema.json).

target_artifact.description: Artifact name as declared in the artifact table, or 'corpus'.

text.description: What is wrong and what is expected.

origin.description: Role or instrument that emitted the note.

round.description: The round that emitted the note, a string such as 'v0.5.0', the same type as the round of the round record. A positive integer is the legacy form the frozen ledger of round 1 keeps (round 1 is the review of the first version); a frozen ledger is never rewritten to the new type.

status.description: Optional: the state of the note. Absent means open.

closed_in.description: Optional: the method version that closed the note (fixed or out of scope).
